cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast from the BBC World Service.
cues.zh: 这里是 BBC 世界服务的《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: I'm Charlotte Gallagher. In the early hours of Saturday, the 29th of August, these are our main stories.
cues.zh: 我是夏洛特·加拉格尔。现在是8月29日星期六凌晨，以下是主要新闻。

cues.en: Donald Trump says the US has reached a huge oil deal with Venezuela.
cues.zh: 唐纳德·特朗普说，美国已与委内瑞拉达成一项巨额石油协议。

cues.en: Also in this podcast: human rights violated, but not genocide.
cues.zh: 本期节目还将报道：人权受到侵犯，但不构成种族灭绝。

cues.en: Two reports on the forced contraception of women and girls in Greenland have been published.
cues.zh: 两份关于格陵兰妇女和女孩遭强制避孕的报告已经发布。

cues.en: L'honneur, le bon sens, l'intérêt supérieur de la Patrie.
cues.zh: 荣誉、常识、祖国的最高利益。

cues.en: We learn more about France's wartime leader in exile.
cues.zh: 我们将进一步了解法国这位流亡海外的战时领袖。

cues.en: But we start with the biggest oil deal in world history. Well, that's according to Donald Trump.
cues.zh: 但我们先从世界历史上规模最大的石油协议说起。当然，这是唐纳德·特朗普的说法。

cues.en: The president has announced an agreement with Venezuela.
cues.zh: 总统宣布已与委内瑞拉达成协议。

cues.en: He says it will more than double US oil reserves and substantially lower petrol prices for Americans.
cues.zh: 他表示，这将使美国石油储量增加一倍以上，并大幅降低美国人的汽油价格。

cues.en: Caracas has welcomed the deal as a historic milestone.
cues.zh: 加拉加斯称这项协议是一个历史性里程碑。

cues.en: The interim leader Delcy Rodríguez said the investment will help the nation's revival.
cues.zh: 临时领导人德尔茜·罗德里格斯说，这项投资将助力国家复兴。

cues.en: Our Latin America expert in Miami, Luis Fajardo, has been telling me more.
cues.zh: 驻迈阿密的拉丁美洲事务专家路易斯·法哈多将为我们进一步解读。

cues.en: Certainly, we're talking about a very big deal, according to what President Trump said in his social media statement.
cues.zh: 当然，这是一项规模非常大的协议——根据特朗普总统在社交媒体声明中的说法。

cues.en: He mentioned 65 billion barrels, estimated to be nearly one-fifth of Venezuela's oil reserves.
cues.zh: 他提到650亿桶石油，据估计接近委内瑞拉石油储量的五分之一。

cues.en: Of course, Venezuela is one of the countries with the biggest oil reserves in the world.
cues.zh: 当然，委内瑞拉是世界上石油储量最大的国家之一。

cues.en: Also, Marco Rubio, the US Secretary of State, was posting on social media saying that $100 billion in investment would go to Venezuela.
cues.zh: 此外，美国国务卿马可·鲁比奥在社交媒体发文称，将有1000亿美元投资流向委内瑞拉。

cues.en: This is precisely the amount of money that some experts have suggested would be needed to restore the Venezuelan oil industry.
cues.zh: 一些专家认为，恢复委内瑞拉石油业恰恰需要这笔资金。

cues.en: Which has suffered terribly in the last decade, or even more.
cues.zh: 该行业在过去十年甚至更长时间里一直饱受重创。

cues.en: Because of mismanagement and all the turmoil that has confronted Venezuela in the last few years.
cues.zh: 原因在于管理不善，以及委内瑞拉近几年面临的种种动荡。

cues.en: So, I think this will probably be seen as a win for Donald Trump ahead of the midterms.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，在中期选举前，这很可能会被视为唐纳德·特朗普的一场胜利。

cues.en: What do you think Caracas will make of this?
cues.zh: 你认为加拉加斯会如何看待这件事？

cues.en: There's certainly going to be some eyebrows raised in at least parts of the Venezuelan government.
cues.zh: 委内瑞拉政府至少部分人士肯定会对此感到惊讶。

cues.en: This goes against, of course, the entire ideology of the Bolivarian Revolution of Hugo Chávez and Nicolás Maduro.
cues.zh: 当然，这与雨果·查韦斯和尼古拉斯·马杜罗所代表的玻利瓦尔革命的整体意识形态背道而驰。

cues.en: They were the people who, with Delcy Rodríguez, originally came to government through that movement.
cues.zh: 他们正是与德尔茜·罗德里格斯一道，最初通过这场运动进入政府的人。

cues.en: It was all about economic nationalism and control of natural resources.
cues.zh: 这场运动强调经济民族主义以及对自然资源的控制。

cues.en: This goes in the opposite direction.
cues.zh: 而这项协议走向了相反的方向。

cues.en: But on the other hand, there's going to be people in Venezuela saying that these oil resources have been drastically mismanaged in the last decade.
cues.zh: 但另一方面，委内瑞拉也会有人说，这些石油资源在过去十年中一直遭到严重的管理不善。

cues.en: This brought economic chaos to Venezuela.
cues.zh: 这给委内瑞拉带来了经济混乱。

cues.en: And if this oil deal brings prosperity again to the country, certainly people will have a different opinion on that.
cues.zh: 如果这项石油协议能让这个国家再次繁荣，人们对此的看法当然会不同。

cues.en: Because, I mean, it's definitely true that the US is exerting increasing influence on Venezuela since Maduro was ousted.
cues.zh: 因为，确实可以说，自马杜罗被赶下台以来，美国一直在加强对委内瑞拉的影响。

cues.en: It has, but on the other hand, it has been a delicate balance, because in many aspects
cues.zh: 确实如此，但另一方面，这一直是一种微妙的平衡，因为在许多方面，

cues.en: the US is working with a government, the Chavista government of Delcy Rodríguez,
cues.zh: 美国正与一个政府合作，也就是德尔茜·罗德里格斯领导的查韦斯主义政府，

cues.en: Which still controls a lot of aspects of domestic life in Venezuela.
cues.zh: 该政府仍控制着委内瑞拉国内生活的许多方面。

cues.en: There is still very big criticism of political prisoners still being in Venezuela.
cues.zh: 对于政治犯仍被关押在委内瑞拉，外界依然有强烈批评。

cues.en: So it is difficult to know up to what point
cues.zh: 因此很难判断到什么程度，

cues.en: the US government was actually doing or making the decisions on the ground at a micro level,
cues.zh: 美国政府实际上是在基层执行决策，还是在微观层面作出决策，

cues.en: but certainly at the macro level, big decisions like this suggest
cues.zh: 但毫无疑问，在宏观层面，这样的重大决定表明，

cues.en: that the US government has created a huge, huge change in the political priorities and even the national priorities of Venezuela
cues.zh: 美国政府已经让委内瑞拉的政治优先事项、乃至国家优先事项发生了巨大变化，

cues.en: since the military actions of early 2026. Luis Fajardo.
cues.zh: 这种变化始于2026年初的军事行动。路易斯·法哈多。

cues.en: The number of people missing after Wednesday's flash floods in Nepal has doubled to nearly 2,000, including many foreign nationals.
cues.zh: 尼泊尔周三突发洪水后，失踪人数已增至近2000人，其中包括许多外国公民。

cues.en: More than 570 people are known to have died when a huge torrent of rock, ice and mud was unleashed
cues.zh: 已知有570多人死亡；当时岩石、冰块和泥浆组成的巨大洪流倾泻而下，

cues.en: by the collapse of a glacier in the Himalayan region
cues.zh: 原因是喜马拉雅地区一座冰川崩塌，

cues.en: and even as rescue efforts continue, there are fears of further sudden floods.
cues.zh: 即使救援仍在继续，人们仍担心会发生更多突发洪水。

cues.en: Azadeh Moshiri sent this report from one of the worst-hit areas of Nepal.
cues.zh: 阿扎德·莫希里从尼泊尔受灾最严重的地区之一发回报道。

cues.en: I've reached army barracks in Trishuli in northern Nepal.
cues.zh: 我已抵达尼泊尔北部特里苏利的军营。

cues.en: Every few minutes, helicopters are landing, dropping off people stranded by the floods—survivors and injured people.
cues.zh: 每隔几分钟就有直升机降落，送来被洪水困住的人——幸存者和伤者。

cues.en: And on the other side of the gate are just some of the people who are waiting for news of their loved ones.
cues.zh: 而在大门另一侧，有一些人在等待亲人的消息。

cues.en: Families are going up to a wall here with a list of the names of people the army has recovered so far, people who have been found.
cues.zh: 一些家庭来到这里的墙边，墙上列着军方迄今找到的人员名单。

cues.en: One of the people here desperate for news is Sujata Joshi. She tells me four of her family members are missing.
cues.zh: 这里一位焦急等待消息的人是苏贾塔·乔希。她告诉我，她有四名家人失踪。

cues.en: Who in your family is missing?
cues.zh: 你家里谁失踪了？

cues.en: My sister-in-law.
cues.zh: 我的嫂子。

cues.en: My cousin, my nephew, and niece.
cues.zh: 我的表亲、侄子和侄女。

cues.en: Her brother Sumit is here, and he tells me that when the flood hit his home, he ran with his wife and child. He survived. They were washed away.
cues.zh: 她的哥哥苏米特也在这里。他告诉我，洪水袭击家中时，他带着妻子和孩子逃跑。他活了下来，他们却被洪水冲走了。

cues.en: We were at home. When the flooding started, I rushed out.
cues.zh: 我们当时在家。洪水开始后，我冲了出去。

cues.en: I asked my sister-in-law to hurry, but she was busy closing up our shop and got caught in the floods.
cues.zh: 我让嫂子快一点，但她正忙着关店，结果被洪水困住了。

cues.en: One of the helicopters has just dropped off Balbir BK, who was stranded while working at a tunnel in Trishuli.
cues.zh: 一架直升机刚刚送下巴尔比尔·BK，他在特里苏利一条隧道工作时被困。

cues.en: We didn't know about the flood. We saw a huge cloud of brown dust from inside the tunnel.
cues.zh: 我们不知道发生了洪水。我们在隧道里看到一大片棕色尘雾。

cues.en: We felt a gust of cold air. We didn't know what was happening.
cues.zh: 我们感到一阵冷风。我们不知道发生了什么。

cues.en: One of the army spokespeople here, Brigadier Rajaram Basnet, explained how difficult it is to rescue people from tunnels here.
cues.zh: 这里的一名军方发言人拉贾拉姆·巴斯内特准将解释了从当地隧道中救人的困难。

cues.en: Even the tunnels' entry and exit points are closed, and they're very difficult to locate.
cues.zh: 即使是隧道，出入口也封闭了，而且很难找到。

cues.en: I haven't seen this kind of, you know, disaster in my life.
cues.zh: 我这辈子从没见过这样的灾难。

cues.en: The warnings have eased now, and emergency officials are letting people leave and get closer to the river.
cues.zh: 现在警报已经减弱，应急官员允许人们离开并靠近河边。

cues.en: We're right next to the Trishuli River now, and the helicopters are still flying up above as search and rescue operations continue.
cues.zh: 我们现在就在特里苏利河边，搜救行动仍在继续，直升机还在上空飞行。

cues.en: It just goes to show how worried people are.
cues.zh: 这正说明人们有多么担心。

cues.en: The number of casualties has continued to rise, and there's an anxious wait for the hundreds who are still missing.
cues.zh: 伤亡人数持续上升，数百名仍然失踪者的家人正焦急等待。

cues.en: We've also just heard the Prime Minister Balen Shah and his cabinet have decided to donate a month's wages to the government's relief fund.
cues.zh: 我们刚刚还获悉，巴伦·沙阿总理及其内阁决定将一个月的工资捐给政府救济基金。

cues.en: A little over six months in office, and Balen Shah is now responding to the worst disaster Nepal has seen in more than a decade.
cues.zh: 上任刚刚六个多月的巴伦·沙阿，正在应对尼泊尔十多年来最严重的灾难。

cues.en: Azadeh Moshiri in Nepal.
cues.zh: 尼泊尔的阿扎德·莫希里报道。

cues.en: In Sudan, the military-led government has lifted a two-year curfew and state of emergency in the capital Khartoum.
cues.zh: 在苏丹，由军方领导的政府解除了首都喀土穆为期两年的宵禁和紧急状态。

cues.en: It's 18 months since the army seized back control of the city from the paramilitary Rapid Support Forces, or RSF.
cues.zh: 军队从准军事组织快速支援部队（RSF）手中夺回该市控制权，至今已有18个月。

cues.en: But the civil war, now in its fourth year, rages on elsewhere.
cues.zh: 但这场已进入第四年的内战仍在其他地区肆虐。

cues.en: During the state of emergency, Khalid Mohammed Al-Bageer ran food kitchens for thousands.
cues.zh: 紧急状态期间，哈立德·穆罕默德·阿勒-巴吉尔为数千人运营供餐厨房。

cues.en: The BBC's Paul Henley asked him about the lifting of the curfew and what life was like before.
cues.zh: BBC记者保罗·亨利询问了他解除宵禁的情况，以及此前的生活。

cues.en: It was really horrible during those days.
cues.zh: 那段日子确实非常糟糕。

cues.en: People, they don't have work, they don't have any resource of income,
cues.zh: 人们没有工作，也没有任何收入来源，

cues.en: so they were faced like a lot of problems of hunger, needing medicine, etc.
cues.zh: 所以他们面临饥饿、需要药品等许多问题。

cues.en: There are still security checkpoints, there's still an army presence in the capital, isn't there?
cues.zh: 首都仍有安检站，军队也仍驻扎在那里，对吧？

cues.en: It's more by the police, not by the army, right.
cues.zh: 现在主要是警察，不是军队。

cues.en: So what's changed? What's different?
cues.zh: 那么，什么变了？有什么不同？

cues.en: Oh, it's a lot of differences.
cues.zh: 变化非常大。

cues.en: Now people feel more safe. They can move freely. The business can work till late night.
cues.zh: 现在人们感觉更安全了，可以自由行动，商家也能营业到深夜。

cues.en: There are so many impacts in different ways, like inner impact.
cues.zh: 影响体现在许多方面，比如内心的感受。

cues.en: The feeling of being safe. In Khartoum now, people can move, like they can cross the bridge, etc.
cues.zh: 比如安全感。如今在喀土穆，人们可以自由行动，可以过桥等等。

cues.en: Even for the business, it's good. Taxi drivers can work, small shops can work, any other businesses can work better.
cues.zh: 这对商业也有好处：出租车司机可以工作，小商店可以营业，其他生意也能运转得更好。

cues.en: Do you think all those people who fled the capital will now start to come home?
cues.zh: 你认为那些逃离首都的人现在会开始回家吗？

cues.en: Yeah, most of them, except the people who don't have any fund to repair their houses, the destroyed houses.
cues.zh: 会，大多数人会回来，除了那些没有资金修缮被毁房屋的人。

cues.en: I think if the government work hard to make life more easier,
cues.zh: 我认为，如果政府努力让生活变得更容易，

cues.en: I mean, the basics, electricity, water, etc., more people will come back to the capital.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，电力、供水等基本生活条件改善后，会有更多人回到首都。

cues.en: What kind of economic price have you paid during this war? You run hotels in Khartoum, is that right?
cues.zh: 这场战争让你付出了怎样的经济代价？你在喀土穆经营酒店，对吗？

cues.en: Yeah, exactly. It was horrible. It was fully destroyed.
cues.zh: 是的，没错。情况糟透了，酒店被彻底毁掉。

cues.en: They stole everything, the appliances, the computer system, even the security cams.
cues.zh: 他们偷走了一切：电器、电脑系统，甚至监控摄像头。

cues.en: And are the basics for daily life returning? Is the power back on and reliable?
cues.zh: 日常生活的基本条件恢复了吗？电力恢复并稳定供应了吗？

cues.en: Yeah, but it's not stable. But it's better than before.
cues.zh: 恢复了，但还不稳定。不过比以前好。

cues.en: Now I'm in the office with the AC working and the lights on, and I have water. It's better.
cues.zh: 我现在在办公室里，空调在运转，灯也亮着，还有水。情况好多了。

cues.en: Do you think that the military government has a real chance of winning this war?
cues.zh: 你认为军政府真的有机会赢得这场战争吗？

cues.en: Only in one case: if the countries that are supporting the RSF stopped.
cues.zh: 只有一种情况：支持RSF的国家停止支持。

cues.en: That was Khalid Mohammed Al-Bageer in Khartoum.
cues.zh: 以上是喀土穆的哈立德·穆罕默德·阿勒-巴吉尔。

cues.en: People are saying the world around us is changing, and that's very true.
cues.zh: 人们都说我们周围的世界正在变化，这确实如此。

cues.en: But I do think that that does not mean that we have to lock ourselves in an agreement with the European Union.
cues.zh: 但我确实认为，这并不意味着我们必须把自己锁定在与欧盟达成的协议中。

cues.en: Iceland holds a referendum on whether to restart talks on joining the European Union.
cues.zh: 冰岛就是否重启加入欧盟的谈判举行公投。

cues.en: This is the Global News Podcast.
cues.zh: 这里是《全球新闻播客》。

cues.en: Milo Yiannopoulos once called himself the most fabulous supervillain on the internet
cues.zh: 米洛·扬诺普洛斯曾称自己是互联网上最华丽的超级恶棍，

cues.en: courting controversy with his remarks about Islam, feminists, and race.
cues.zh: 他的言论涉及伊斯兰教、女权主义者和种族问题，因而不断引发争议。

cues.en: The British far-right commentator, who lives in the US, was an early supporter of Donald Trump and the MAGA movement.
cues.zh: 这名居住在美国的英国极右翼评论员，曾是唐纳德·特朗普和MAGA运动的早期支持者。

cues.en: But the 41-year-old has now found himself on the wrong side of the strict immigration policies he's publicly endorsed.
cues.zh: 但这名41岁的人如今却站到了自己公开支持的严苛移民政策的对立面。

cues.en: He's been detained by ICE and is awaiting deportation.
cues.zh: 他已被美国移民与海关执法局拘留，正等待被驱逐出境。

cues.en: Our correspondent Shaima Khalil told me more.
cues.zh: 我们的记者沙伊玛·哈利勒告诉我更多详情。

cues.en: Milo Yiannopoulos is a self-styled provocateur.
cues.zh: 米洛·扬诺普洛斯自称是挑衅者。

cues.en: People may remember him from the first Trump administration.
cues.zh: 人们或许还记得他在特朗普第一届政府时期的经历。

cues.en: He rose to prominence really as an editor of Breitbart, a very prominent conservative publication at the time.
cues.zh: 他当时正是作为《布赖特巴特》的一名编辑崭露头角的；那是很有影响力的保守派出版物。

cues.en: He was an editor, he was a news editor there,
cues.zh: 他是那里的一名编辑，担任新闻编辑，

cues.en: but he was so outspoken against everything: the Black Lives Matter movement, feminism, and transgender people.
cues.zh: 但他公开强烈反对一切：黑人的命也是命运动、女权主义以及跨性别人群。

cues.en: And he was an early supporter of Donald Trump during the 2016 election,
cues.zh: 在2016年大选期间，他还是唐纳德·特朗普的早期支持者，

cues.en: headlining events called "Gays for Trump" during the Republican National Convention.
cues.zh: 并在共和党全国代表大会期间，为名为“同性恋支持特朗普”的活动担任主讲。

cues.en: He backed President Trump's tighter immigration restrictions in the United States
cues.zh: 他支持特朗普总统在美国实施更严格的移民限制，

cues.en: and then he had a recent fallout with Mr Trump and the Trump administration.
cues.zh: 但最近他与特朗普先生及其政府发生了冲突。

cues.en: He said that he'd lost his way.
cues.zh: 他说自己迷失了方向。

cues.en: He more recently was working for Kanye West, again a very controversial figure, obviously the rapper in the music industry.
cues.zh: 最近他还曾为坎耶·韦斯特工作；后者也是极具争议的人物，显然是音乐界的说唱歌手。

cues.en: But this is where people would remember him.
cues.zh: 不过，人们会记住他的正是这一点。

cues.en: Recently, though, we haven't heard much about him or from him.
cues.zh: 不过最近，我们很少听到关于他的消息，也很少听到他的声音。

cues.en: So when the news came out today that he was arrested by ICE,
cues.zh: 所以今天传出他被ICE逮捕的消息时，

cues.en: I think it took everybody by surprise.
cues.zh: 我想这让所有人都感到意外。

cues.en: Do we know yet why he's been detained?
cues.zh: 我们知道他为何被拘留了吗？

cues.en: Well, we have a statement from ICE now, from the US Immigration and Customs Enforcement.
cues.zh: 现在我们有一份ICE，也就是美国移民与海关执法局的声明。

cues.en: They said that they had arrested
cues.zh: 声明说，他们逮捕了他，

cues.en: They described him as an "illegal alien from the United Kingdom" in New Orleans International Airport.
cues.zh: 他们称他是来自英国的“非法外国人”，并在新奥尔良国际机场将其逮捕。

cues.en: And that he had entered the United States...
cues.zh: 声明还称他曾进入美国……

cues.en: legally in 2019, but as the statement put it, he had chosen to overstay his welcome.
cues.zh: 他于2019年合法入境，但正如声明所说，他选择逾期停留。

cues.en: ICE says that he had failed to attend an immigration hearing.
cues.zh: 美国移民与海关执法局称，他未参加移民听证会。

cues.en: He was issued with a final removal order last month, and then he was arrested today.
cues.zh: 他上个月收到最终遣返令，随后于今天被捕。

cues.en: We also know that he will remain in ICE custody pending removal or pending deportation.
cues.zh: 我们还知道，在被遣返或驱逐出境前，他将继续由美国移民局拘押。

cues.en: Some might say ironically, Shaima, he was a very big supporter of ICE.
cues.zh: 沙伊玛，有人或许会讽刺地说，他曾是美国移民局的坚定支持者。

cues.en: Just looking at his tweets from last year, he says, "Total legal immunity for ICE agents when they're on duty."
cues.zh: 只看他去年的推文，他就曾说：“美国移民局执勤人员应享有全面法律豁免。”

cues.en: We've got to deport millions and millions and millions of people. Without that, nothing else matters.
cues.zh: 我们必须驱逐数百万、数百万、数百万的人。没有做到这一点，其他一切都无关紧要。

cues.en: Exactly. And for a person who was so outspoken about deporting people,
cues.zh: 确实如此。对于一个如此公开主张驱逐他人的人，

cues.en: who was so outspoken in favor of essentially what ICE is doing right now,
cues.zh: 一个如此公开支持美国移民局如今所做之事的人，

cues.en: of Donald Trump's policies about immigration, for this particular person to be then detained by ICE is quite ironic.
cues.zh: 尤其是支持特朗普移民政策的这个人，后来却被美国移民局拘留，实在颇具讽刺意味。

cues.en: Indeed, is painfully ironic to be himself called an illegal alien and to be eventually deported by ICE. Shaima Khalil.
cues.zh: 的确，这非常讽刺：他本人被称为“非法外国人”，最终还将被美国移民局驱逐出境。

cues.en: Experts say Denmark's campaign of forced contraception on women and girls in Greenland
cues.zh: 专家称，丹麦对格陵兰妇女和女孩实施的强制避孕，

cues.en: in the 1960s and seventies violated human rights, but did not meet the legal definition of genocide.
cues.zh: 发生在20世纪60至70年代，侵犯了人权，但不符合法律上对种族灭绝的定义。

cues.en: Two long-awaited reports were released on Friday and both found that the women's rights were breached.
cues.zh: 两份期待已久的报告于周五发布，均认定女性权利受到侵犯。

cues.en: More than 4,000 Inuit women and girls, who were the main ethnic group in Greenland, were given IUDs or coils,
cues.zh: 超过4000名因纽特妇女和女孩——她们是格陵兰的主要族群——被放置了宫内节育器，

cues.en: often without their consent. Many say they suffered pain and trauma, and some were left sterile, like this woman, Inga Platu.
cues.zh: 而且往往未经同意。许多人说她们遭受了疼痛和创伤，有些人因此不孕，例如这位名叫英加·普拉图的女子。

cues.en: Jeg fik ikke noget at vide om at jeg skulle have spiral op.
cues.zh: 我没有被告知要给我放置宫内节育器。

cues.en: I wasn't told anything about me having an IUD inserted.
cues.zh: 我没有被告知要给我放置宫内节育器。

cues.en: I was in hospital for a minor operation in my pelvic area.
cues.zh: 我当时因盆腔部位的小手术住院。

cues.en: When I came round, an IUD had been fitted without me being asked first. I was 20 years old.
cues.zh: 我醒来时，宫内节育器已经被放入体内，事先没人征求我的同意。我当时20岁。

cues.en: I'd imagined my future with more children, but I wasn't able to.
cues.zh: 我曾设想未来再要几个孩子，但我没能如愿。

cues.en: I envied my friends who were having children and starting families.
cues.zh: 我羡慕那些正在生儿育女、组建家庭的朋友。

cues.en: We decided to adopt.
cues.zh: 我们决定收养孩子。

cues.en: The practice was so widespread that Greenland's population growth severely slowed.
cues.zh: 这种做法如此普遍，以至于格陵兰的人口增长大幅放缓。

cues.en: Greenland is a self-governing territory of Denmark, which will pay around $47,000 to each affected woman.
cues.zh: 格陵兰是丹麦的自治领土，丹麦将向每名受影响的女性支付约4.7万美元。

cues.en: I got more from our Denmark correspondent, Adrienne Murray.
cues.zh: 丹麦记者阿德里安·默里带来了更多消息。

cues.en: Two separate reports have been published by Greenland's government.
cues.zh: 格陵兰政府发布了两份独立报告。

cues.en: Now, initially, they commissioned one panel to investigate or examine what the legal aspects of this case were.
cues.zh: 最初，他们委托一个小组调查或审视此案涉及的法律问题。

cues.en: So that's whether human rights violations had occurred and also, crucially, whether this would constitute genocide.
cues.zh: 也就是调查是否发生侵犯人权的行为，以及更关键的，这是否构成种族灭绝。

cues.en: Now, this happened about a year and a half ago.
cues.zh: 这件事发生在大约一年半以前。

cues.en: The experts behind that panel, they had a disagreement, and they split into two groups.
cues.zh: 该小组的专家之间产生了分歧，于是分成了两组。

cues.en: There are now two reports, authored by two different groups.
cues.zh: 结果是，现在发布了两份报告，分别由两组不同的专家撰写。

cues.en: Now, in terms of the findings that the government presented,
cues.zh: 就政府公布的调查结果而言，

cues.en: both of these reports concluded that there were cases of forced contraception,
cues.zh: 两份报告都认定存在强制避孕案例，

cues.en: and that there were violations of the women's human rights,
cues.zh: 并认定女性的人权受到侵犯，

cues.en: but neither established that genocide had occurred.
cues.zh: 但两份报告都未认定发生了种族灭绝。

cues.en: The first group, the Danish experts, they said there was no empirical evidence to suggest genocide at all,
cues.zh: 第一组丹麦专家称，完全没有实证证据表明发生了种族灭绝，

cues.en: and they concluded there was no intention proven.
cues.zh: 并认定没有证据证明存在这种意图。

cues.en: The second report by two international experts, however, was a bit more nuanced.
cues.zh: 不过，第二份由两名国际专家撰写的报告更加细致。

cues.en: They did not establish genocide, but this report, however, said
cues.zh: 他们没有认定构成种族灭绝，但这份报告说，

cues.en: there were reasonable grounds to believe that involuntary contraception was actually systematic,
cues.zh: 有合理理由相信，非自愿避孕实际上是系统性的，

cues.en: that it was discriminatory, and that, in their view, however, on this genocide issue, only a court can decide.
cues.zh: 并且具有歧视性，但他们认为，关于种族灭绝这一问题，只有法院才能作出裁决。

cues.en: So they stopped short in that capacity, in terms of their conclusions.
cues.zh: 因此，就结论而言，他们在这一点上没有下定论。

cues.en: That was Adrienne Murray.
cues.zh: 以上是阿德里安·默里。

cues.en: A decade after Iceland broke off negotiations to join the European Union,
cues.zh: 冰岛中止加入欧盟谈判十年后，

cues.en: voters are deciding whether or not to start talking about applying for membership in the future.
cues.zh: 选民正在决定未来是否重新启动入盟申请谈判。

cues.en: Early polling shows the result could be very close.
cues.zh: 早期民调显示，结果可能会非常接近。

cues.en: Here's the top headline on the national broadcaster. They're saying that big queues were reported in the capital, Reykjavík,
cues.zh: 下面是国家广播公司的头条报道。据报道，首都雷克雅未克出现了长长的队伍，

cues.en: on Friday as people lined up for early voting.
cues.zh: 周五人们排队进行提前投票。

cues.en: Now, Iceland is already part of the European Economic Area, and residents have the right to travel and work throughout the European Union.
cues.zh: 冰岛已经是欧洲经济区的一员，居民有权在整个欧盟境内旅行和工作。

cues.en: But Donald Trump's threats over Greenland, its vast neighbour to the northwest, have left some in Iceland wondering whether they should join the EU.
cues.zh: 但特朗普对格陵兰的威胁——这个位于冰岛西北方的广大邻地——让一些冰岛人开始思考是否应加入欧盟。

cues.en: The BBC's Shaun Ley brought together two young voters.
cues.zh: BBC记者肖恩·莱邀请了两名年轻选民。

cues.en: In a moment, we'll hear from Magnea Jóhannesdóttir, a deputy member of Reykjavík City Council, who plans to vote no.
cues.zh: 稍后我们将听到雷克雅未克市议会副议员玛格妮娅·约翰内斯多蒂尔的看法，她计划投反对票。

cues.en: But first, here's Thórnhildur Davíðsdóttir Sævarck, vice chair of the pro-European Icelandic Youth, who plans to vote yes.
cues.zh: 但首先请听亲欧的冰岛青年组织副主席索恩希尔杜尔·达维兹多蒂尔·赛瓦克，她计划投赞成票。

cues.en: I think it's just the changed reality, the changed geopolitical circumstances.
cues.zh: 我认为，这只是现实和地缘政治形势发生了变化。

cues.en: I think. We belong most with Europe.
cues.zh: 我认为，我们最应与欧洲站在一起。

cues.en: I think we share a lot of values of democracy and human rights.
cues.zh: 我认为，我们在民主和人权方面有许多共同价值。

cues.en: The US has been a historically very strong ally for Iceland,
cues.zh: 美国历来都是冰岛非常强大的盟友，

cues.en: but, like now, with a new leadership, they're becoming more unreliable, untrustworthy.
cues.zh: 但如今随着新领导层上台，美国正变得更加不可靠、不值得信任。

cues.en: You can't really know what they're going to do next.
cues.zh: 你实在无法知道他们下一步会做什么。

cues.en: Magnea, does that worry you?
cues.zh: 玛格妮娅，这让你担心吗？

cues.en: What's happening around Iceland at the moment? People are saying the world around us is
cues.zh: 此刻冰岛周围发生了什么？有人说，我们周围的世界正在

cues.en: changing, and that's very true.
cues.zh: 世界正在变化，这一点确实如此。

cues.en: But I do think that that does not mean that we have to lock ourselves in a trade agreement with the European Union.
cues.zh: 但我认为，这并不意味着我们必须把自己锁定在与欧盟的贸易协定中。

cues.en: We do have trade agreements, e.g., with China, that might be put at risk if we join the European Union.
cues.zh: 我们确实有贸易协定，例如与中国的协定；如果加入欧盟，这些协定可能会受到影响。

cues.en: When it comes to protection, we are a founding member of NATO.
cues.zh: 在安全保障方面，我们是北约创始成员。

cues.en: We have a bilateral protection agreement with the United States of America, and we are a part of the European Economic Area.
cues.zh: 我们与美国有双边安全保障协议，也是欧洲经济区的一部分。

cues.en: So we do have strong ties with Europe.
cues.zh: 所以，我们与欧洲确实联系紧密。

cues.en: We are part of their single market.
cues.zh: 我们是欧洲单一市场的一部分。

cues.en: We can go and work and study everywhere else.
cues.zh: 我们可以去欧洲其他地方工作和学习。

cues.en: So Hilda, that's a good point, isn't it?
cues.zh: 希尔达，你说得有道理，对吧？

cues.en: I mean, it's hard to see what the advantage would be of joining the EU, certainly on an economic ground.
cues.zh: 我的意思是，加入欧盟有什么优势很难看出来，尤其从经济角度而言。

cues.en: We don't have any say; we don't have a seat at the table in EU institutions, and now we're kind of in the EEA Agreement, sheltered by Norway.
cues.zh: 我们没有发言权，也无法在欧盟机构中占有一席之地；现在我们算是受挪威庇护、处于欧洲经济区协定之内。

cues.en: But I think if Norway were to join, Iceland's negotiating power would decline significantly.
cues.zh: 但我认为，如果挪威加入，冰岛的谈判能力将大幅下降。

cues.en: Which I think is one of the biggest reasons for joining the European Union for Iceland would be to adopt the euro.
cues.zh: 我认为，这正是冰岛加入欧盟的最大原因之一：采用欧元。

cues.en: So now in Iceland, we have the Icelandic krona, which is the smallest independent floating currency in the world.
cues.zh: 如今，冰岛使用冰岛克朗，这是世界上规模最小的独立浮动货币。

cues.en: We have sky-high interest rates.
cues.zh: 我们的利率高得惊人。

cues.en: We're still not in the customs union, so we're still paying tariffs both ways.
cues.zh: 我们仍未加入关税同盟，所以进出口双方仍要缴纳关税。

cues.en: That increases the grocery prices and just makes the cost of living in Iceland significantly harder.
cues.zh: 这推高了食品杂货价格，也让冰岛的生活成本大幅上升。

cues.en: Magna, I am not a big fan of internationally outsourcing power and authority.
cues.zh: 玛格妮娅，我不太赞成把权力和决策权交由国际机构。

cues.en: Joining the EU would mean that we would have to change our constitution.
cues.zh: 加入欧盟意味着我们必须修改宪法。

cues.en: Our seat at the table is very small.
cues.zh: 我们在谈判桌上的席位很少。

cues.en: We are a small nation of only 400,000 people.
cues.zh: 我们是一个只有40万人口的小国。

cues.en: That means that we only get six seats at the European Parliament, which is under 1% of the votes.
cues.zh: 这意味着我们在欧洲议会只有6个席位，占总票数不到1%。

cues.en: And I do fear that we would just drown in that regulation in there because we don't have the power right now.
cues.zh: 我确实担心，我们会淹没在那些法规中，因为我们现在没有这样的权力。

cues.en: We're part of the European Economic Area, we can say no to things in there, and in the end, it's our parliament that implements the law.
cues.zh: 我们属于欧洲经济区，可以拒绝其中的一些事项，最终由我们的议会实施法律。

cues.en: It's not the European Union.
cues.zh: 实施法律的不是欧盟。

cues.en: Having an independent currency is a good thing, and the krona has been a shock absorber when Iceland experiences economic crisis or shocks.
cues.zh: 拥有独立货币是好事；冰岛遭遇经济危机或冲击时，克朗一直发挥着缓冲作用。

cues.en: When it comes to young people and voting, the polls now in Iceland are showing that 60% of young people from 18 to 29 are actually going to vote no.
cues.zh: 说到年轻人和投票，冰岛目前的民调显示，18至29岁的年轻人中有60%确实打算投反对票。

cues.en: They don't want to join the European Union.
cues.zh: 他们不想加入欧盟。

cues.en: Next, more than 200 wild elephants died in Sri Lanka in the first eight months of this year.
cues.zh: 接下来，今年前八个月，斯里兰卡有超过200头野生大象死亡。

cues.en: The Wildlife Conservation Department says nearly 90 of them were killed by farmers.
cues.zh: 野生动物保护部门称，其中近90头是被农民杀死的。

cues.en: Our global affairs correspondent Anbarasan Ethirajan has more details.
cues.zh: 本台全球事务记者阿纳巴拉桑·埃蒂拉詹带来更多详情。

cues.en: Elephants are considered sacred in Sri Lanka.
cues.zh: 在斯里兰卡，大象被视为神圣动物。

cues.en: Nevertheless, since 2021, the average number of deaths each year has reached 400, triggering concerns over their long-term future in the island nation.
cues.zh: 然而，自2021年以来，大象年均死亡数已达400头，引发人们对其在这个岛国长期生存前景的担忧。

cues.en: The increasing encounters between humans and wild elephants are proving deadly.
cues.zh: 人与野生大象日益频繁的相遇正造成致命后果。

cues.en: Many of the elephants were shot or came into contact with illegal electric fences.
cues.zh: 许多大象遭到枪击，或接触了非法电网。

cues.en: Twenty-six that died this year had consumed jaw bombs, explosives hidden in food that detonate inside the animal's mouth.
cues.zh: 今年死亡的大象中有26头吃下了“颚炸弹”，这种炸药藏在食物中，会在动物口中爆炸。

cues.en: Killing elephants, which are endangered, is illegal in Sri Lanka and can carry the death penalty, but this is rarely enforced.
cues.zh: 大象属于濒危动物，在斯里兰卡杀害大象属违法行为，可判死刑，但这一规定很少执行。

cues.en: Scores of people also get killed by elephants every year.
cues.zh: 每年也有许多人被大象杀死。

cues.en: An estimated 5,800 elephants roam across Sri Lanka's protected habitats, wetlands, and highlands.
cues.zh: 估计有5800头大象栖息在斯里兰卡的保护区、湿地和高地。

cues.en: But experts warn that if elephant deaths continue to rise at the current rate,
cues.zh: 但专家警告，如果大象死亡继续按当前速度上升，

cues.en: up to 70% of the island's elephant population would be gone in the coming years.
cues.zh: 未来几年，岛上多达70%的大象将会消失。

cues.en: I am Anbarasan Ethirajan.
cues.zh: 我是阿纳巴拉桑·埃蒂拉詹。

cues.en: Finally, millions of people in France have flocked to see a film about the French Second World War leader Charles de Gaulle over the summer.
cues.zh: 最后，今夏数百万法国人涌去观看一部关于二战时期法国领导人夏尔·戴高乐的电影。

cues.en: Now, De Gaulle: Résistance is about to open in the UK and Ireland.
cues.zh: 《戴高乐：抵抗》即将在英国和爱尔兰上映。

cues.en: You chose our side, the side of freedom.
cues.zh: 你选择了我们这一边，自由的一边。

cues.en: You see a child attacked by savages, you'd step in.
cues.zh: 如果你看到一个孩子遭野蛮人袭击，你会出手相助。

cues.en: La France n'est pas un enfant, monsieur le président.
cues.zh: 法国不是一个孩子，总统先生。

cues.en: Elle a toujours continué à se battre.
cues.zh: 她始终在战斗。

cues.en: The film is about France's darkest hour, when German forces occupied the country.
cues.zh: 这部电影讲述法国最黑暗的时刻：德国军队占领了这个国家。

cues.en: De Gaulle, then a little-known figure, had escaped to London, and it was from the BBC studios here in Broadcasting House
cues.zh: 当时还默默无闻的戴高乐逃到了伦敦；正是在这里的广播大厦BBC演播室，

cues.en: on the 18th of June 1940 that he called on the French to resist the Nazis.
cues.zh: 1940年6月18日，他在此呼吁法国人抵抗纳粹。

cues.en: No recording was made, but here's a speech from a few days later.
cues.zh: 当时没有录音，但这是几天后的一段演讲。

cues.en: L'intérêt supérieur de la patrie commande à tous les.
cues.zh: 祖国至高无上的利益要求所有……

cues.en: He was saying, "Honor, common sense, and the interests of the country
cues.zh: 他的意思是：“荣誉、常识以及国家的利益，

cues.en: require that all free Frenchmen, wherever they be, should continue the fight as best they may."
cues.zh: 要求所有自由的法国人，无论身在何处，都应尽其所能继续战斗。”

cues.en: The film was inspired by a book by the British historian Julian Jackson,
cues.zh: 这部电影的灵感来自英国历史学家朱利安·杰克逊的一本书，

cues.en: who's been speaking to my colleague Evan Davis about the French general's tumultuous relationship with his host, the British wartime leader Winston Churchill.
cues.zh: 他一直在和我的同事埃文·戴维斯谈论这位法国将军与东道主、英国战时领导人温斯顿·丘吉尔之间波折的关系。

cues.en: Complicated is an underestimate.
cues.zh: 说它复杂都算轻描淡写。

cues.en: It is a fantastically difficult relationship to understand. A lot
cues.zh: 这段关系复杂得令人难以理解。很多人

cues.en: of people think, "Oh, the two men hated each other."
cues.zh: 很多人认为：“哦，这两个人彼此憎恨。”

cues.en: They spent most of the war quarreling. There's a wonderful, wonderful scene in the film which absolutely happened in reality, where they're shouting at each other.
cues.zh: 战争期间的大部分时间，他们都在争吵。电影中有一幕非常精彩的场景，而且确实发生过：他们正在互相大喊。

cues.en: De Gaulle smashes a chair, leaves the room, and as he's leaving the room,
cues.zh: 戴高乐砸了一把椅子，离开房间；就在他离开时，

cues.en: Clementine Churchill is coming in, and De Gaulle, who's always very polite to women, says, "So, I'm delighted to meet you, Madam."
cues.zh: 克莱门泰因·丘吉尔走了进来。戴高乐一向对女性很有礼貌，便说：“夫人，很高兴见到您。”

cues.en: And she goes in to see her husband and says, "What a charming man!"
cues.zh: 她进去见丈夫，说：“多么迷人的人啊！”

cues.en: So there is an element with De Gaulle of play-acting in his tantrums.
cues.zh: 所以，戴高乐发脾气时，确实有表演的一面。

cues.en: But why the anger? I think because once De Gaulle was in London,
cues.zh: 但他为什么愤怒呢？我认为，这是因为戴高乐到了伦敦，

cues.en: and once he'd established himself, he really needed to show that he wasn't a puppet of the British.
cues.zh: 并站稳脚跟后，非常需要证明自己不是英国人的傀儡。

cues.en: And so he behaved often abysmally to Churchill.
cues.zh: 所以他常常对丘吉尔表现得极其恶劣。

cues.en: He bit the hand that fed him. And why did he bite the hand that fed him? Because he wanted to show that France had teeth.
cues.zh: 他反咬了养活自己的那只手。那他为什么要这样做？因为他想证明法国是有锋芒的。

cues.en: And Churchill, he saw in De Gaulle someone a bit like a romantic,
cues.zh: 丘吉尔认为戴高乐有些像一个浪漫主义者，

cues.en: but he was under pressure from somebody who hated De Gaulle, although he hardly knew him, which was Roosevelt in the United States.
cues.zh: 但他还受到一个痛恨戴高乐之人的压力——那就是美国的罗斯福，尽管罗斯福几乎不了解戴高乐。

cues.en: Talk to me about why this film might be enjoyed now.
cues.zh: 请谈谈为什么如今观众可能会喜欢这部电影。

cues.en: What is surprising about the film, and you can't predict whether a film will be successful or not, is the amazing success
cues.zh: 这部电影令人惊讶之处在于，电影是否成功无法预料，但它取得了惊人的成功，

cues.en: it has seemed to have had in France.
cues.zh: 至少从目前看来，它在法国大获成功。

cues.en: It's given two things.
cues.zh: 它带来了两方面的意义。

cues.en: One, there's a lot of writing about how badly the French behaved in the war, about collaboration, all things that happened, all things that are true.
cues.zh: 一方面，许多文章都在讲法国人在战争中的糟糕表现、通敌，以及那些确实发生过的事情。

cues.en: And I think this is a film that gives the French a sense that they can actually be proud of their country, that there is another story to tell.
cues.zh: 我认为，这部电影让法国人感到，他们其实可以为自己的国家感到骄傲，因为历史还有另一个故事可以讲述。

cues.en: And I've been very struck by quite young people that I know who write to me.
cues.zh: 让我印象很深的是，我认识的一些相当年轻的人写信给我。

cues.en: A young man in his late 20s, he wrote and said, "I went to see the film and I came out and I was crying."
cues.zh: 一名二十多岁快到三十岁的年轻人写信说：“我去看了这部电影，出来时哭了。”

cues.en: So I think there's a legitimate reason to be proud of your country.
cues.zh: 所以我认为，为自己的国家感到骄傲是有正当理由的。

cues.en: This extraordinary, sort of larger-than-life figure who, in some sense, did save his country.
cues.zh: 这个非凡的、近乎传奇的人物，在某种意义上确实拯救了他的国家。

cues.en: He did lots of things that we might not find admirable. He was not in all ways an attractive figure,
cues.zh: 他做过许多我们可能并不赞赏的事情。他并不是一个在各方面都讨人喜欢的人物，

cues.en: but I think it could be said that he saved the honor of France, and I think that's what a lot of French people are responding to.
cues.zh: 但我认为可以说，他挽救了法国的荣誉；我想，这正是许多法国人产生共鸣的地方。

cues.en: He created the most powerful democratic presidency anywhere in the Western world.
cues.zh: 他建立了西方世界最强有力的民主总统制。

cues.en: For all that there are lots of criticisms of the way that the Fifth Republic works, of its authoritarianism, etc.,
cues.zh: 尽管人们对第五共和国的运作方式、其威权主义等有诸多批评，

cues.en: it hasn't served France too badly for the last 50 years.
cues.zh: 但过去五十年来，它对法国的作用并不算太差。

cues.en: I think that that's an extraordinary legacy.
cues.zh: 我认为，这是一份非凡的遗产。

cues.en: That was Julian Jackson. And that's all from us for now.
cues.zh: 刚才是朱利安·杰克逊。今天的节目就到这里。

cues.en: If you want to get in touch, you can email us at globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk.
cues.zh: 如果想联系我们，可以发送邮件至 globalpodcast@bbc.co.uk。

cues.en: You can also find us on X at BBC World Service. Use the hashtag #GlobalNewsPod.
cues.zh: 你也可以在 X 上关注 BBC World Service。请使用话题标签 #GlobalNewsPod。

cues.en: Don't forget our sister podcast, The Global Story.
cues.zh: 别忘了我们的姊妹播客《全球故事》。

cues.en: This edition of the Global News Podcast was mixed by Rebecca Miller, and the producer was Marion Stroud.
cues.zh: 本期《全球新闻播客》由丽贝卡·米勒负责混音，制片人是马里昂·斯特劳德。

cues.en: The editor is Karen Martin, and I'm Charlotte Gallagher.
cues.zh: 编辑是凯伦·马丁，我是夏洛特·加拉格尔。

cues.en: Until next time, goodbye.
cues.zh: 下次再见，拜拜。

cues.en: Hi, I'm Mariko Oi from Asia Pacific, where we bring you Asia Pacific stories unpacked by those who know them best.
cues.zh: 你好，我是《亚太纵横》的 Mariko Oi。我们由最了解这些故事的人，为你深入解读亚太新闻。
